instance_description:
Setting: 2026 personal health maintenance for a Santa Fe ceramics instructor whose studio schedule includes teaching, wheel work, kiln days, local markets, and home recovery routines.
Scope: Covers nonurgent appointment preparation, saved professional guidance, dust and hearing precautions, standing and hand-care routines, fitness conditioning, meal planning, sleep habits, and personal supply checks.
Resources: Empty SQLite tables can later store Yvette-related context, established guidance, and routine logs; blank TXT files can hold guidance, checklists, appointment notes, and supply summaries.
Exclusions: No diagnosis, treatment choice, medication or dosage changes, emergency triage, workplace compliance decisions, insurance disputes, or contacting clinicians or employers without explicit scenario permission.
personal_description:
Identity: Yvette Solana Breck is a 47-year-old ceramics instructor and small-batch potter living in Santa Fe, New Mexico, throughout 2026.
Responsibilities: Yvette manages personal appointments, studio-day wellbeing preparation, stretching and conditioning, meals around teaching shifts, sleep routines, protective personal supplies, and craft-market travel packing.
Authority: Yvette may organize records, set reminders, compare schedules, follow saved clinician, occupational therapist, or trainer guidance, and choose ordinary logistics within established personal plans.
Restrictions: Yvette does not ask the agent to diagnose symptoms, select treatments, alter prescriptions, interpret urgent concerns, or message providers, students, galleries, or the arts center unless authorized in a Scenario.
